title: get_root_directory_listing
description: Test GET request to / endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status code with an HTML listing of the root directory.

title: browse_subdirectory_listing
description: Test GET request to /browse/{path} with a valid subdirectory path to verify it returns a 200 status code with an HTML listing of the specified directory.

title: browse_path_traversal_block
description: Test GET request to /browse/{path} with a path traversal attempt (e.g., ../../etc/passwd) to verify it returns a 403 response blocking path traversal.

title: browse_nonexistent_directory
description: Test GET request to /browse/{path} with a nonexistent directory path to verify it returns a 404 response.

title: download_file_success
description: Test GET request to /download/{path} with a valid file path to verify it returns a 200 FileResponse with the file contents.

title: download_path_is_directory
description: Test GET request to /download/{path} where the path is a directory to verify it returns a 400 response indicating the path is not a file.

title: download_path_traversal_block
description: Test GET request to /download/{path} with a path traversal attempt to verify it returns a 403 response blocking path traversal.

title: download_file_not_found
description: Test GET request to /download/{path} with a missing file path to verify it returns a 404 response indicating the file was not found.

title: upload_files_success
description: Test POST request to /upload with multipart form-data including files and optional valid path to verify it returns a 200 UploadResult confirming saved files.

title: health_check_endpoint
description: Test GET request to /health to verify it returns a 200 response with status and version fields indicating service availability.
